nchronous eval runs.\n30:* **Discover your resources** — list your projects, their servers, eval\n50: pinned skills and plugin ve

rs, test cases) synchronously and get a `suiteId` back; no run is started and no credits are spent\n56:* **Run eval suites asynchr
onously** — create a run from a saved suite, get a `202` + `runId`\n58: usage, latency), and full traces. Runs appear live in the

mpty `{}`). **Reads** — the catalog listings and eval-run polling — are\n159:**Authoring vs running suites.** `POST /eval-suites`
creates a runnable suite\n161:`suiteId`, WITHOUT running anything — author once, run later. `POST /eval-runs`\n164:`GET /eval-runs

n170:lists its eval suites. Start from `GET /me` to confirm which account a key\n214:token to one of its [accounts](#server-accoun
ts), and call again. See\n248:| `GET /me` | The account behind the key |\n255:| `GET /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites` | The proj
ect's eval suites, with latest-run summaries |\n263:standalone server group, optionally pinned skills and plugin versions) that ev
al\n295:| `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE .../accounts[/{account}]` | The server's accounts. See [Server accounts](#server-accounts
) |\n296:| `POST .../oauth/import-tokens` | **Deprecated.** Uploads to your default account; use `PUT .../accounts/{account}`. See
[The deprecated import route](#the-deprecated-import-route) |\n298:**Eval runs** (`/projects/{projectId}/...`):\n302:| `POST .../
eval-suites` | Author-only: create a suite + its test cases from `name` + `serverIds` + a default `model` + `tests`, WITHOUT runni
ng it; responds `201` + `suiteId`. Each test's case body is an ordered `steps` array (prompt / toolCall / interact / assert); per-
test `model`/`provider`/`runs` are optional and fall back to suite defaults |\n303:| `POST .../eval-runs` | Create a run from a `s
uiteId` (rerun; `serverIds` optional — defaults to the suite's saved servers) or `suiteName` + inline `tests` + `serverIds` (new s
uite). `environmentId` (requires `suiteId`) runs against one of the suite's attached environments instead. Responds `202` + `runId
` |\n304:| `PATCH .../eval-suites/{suiteId}` | Edit suite settings, including `environmentIds` — the project environments the suit
e runs against (non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears) |\n305:| `PATCH .../eval-suites/{suiteId}/schedule` | Enable/disable
scheduled runs; `environmentId` pins which environment they launch |\n306:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}` | Run status, result, and
summary — poll until terminal. Carries `gateWaiver`: the audited override in force over this run's gate, or `null` |\n307:| `GET
.../eval-runs/{runId}/gate` | The stored suite quality-gate report for this run (`passed` / `failed` / `non_gateable` / `not_confi
gured`). `not_configured` is a 200 report, never a missing route. A deployment that predates the evaluator answers `422 FEATURE_NO
T_SUPPORTED` |\n308:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/decision-summary` | **Start here when a run did not pass.** The canonical run dec
ision contract: the verdict and where it came from, counts labelled with the population they count, the run's own verdict decision
, and per-trial diagnostics with the user-value chain, the first failed stage, the failure category, evidence scoped to that stage
, and one next action (paginated) |\n309:| `POST .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers` | Override a **failing** run's release gate u
ntil `expiresAt` (required, future, max 30 days out), with a `reason` (required, max 500 chars). Manage tier. Does NOT change the
run's `result` — the run keeps its verdict and the waiver is reported alongside it. `409` when one is already in force, returning
the existing waiver |\n310:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers` | The waiver in force over a run, or `null`. Readable by any
one who can view the run |\n311:| `DELETE .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers/{waiverId}` | Revoke a waiver, putting the gate back.
Idempotent — a second call reports the original revocation rather than restamping it |\n312:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/iteratio
ns` | Per-iteration results: tool calls, token usage, latency (paginated) |\n313:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/iterations/{iteratio
nId}/trace` | Full trace: messages + expected-vs-actual analysis |\n314:| `GET .../eval-suites/{suiteId}/runs` | Recent runs for a
suite, newest first |\n316:**Eval result ingestion** (`/projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/...`) — how `@mcpjam/sdk` saves results
from eval runs executed outside the platform (local dev, CI). The `{projectId}` segment accepts the literal `default` for the key
org's Default project. Most users never call these directly — set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` and the [SDK reporter](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
sdk/concepts/saving-results.md) does:\n320:| `POST .../eval-ingest/report` | One-shot: create a run from finished results and fina
lize it |\n321:| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/start` | Chunked flow: create (or idempotently reuse) a run by `externalRunId` |\n322:
| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/iterations` | Append an iteration batch to a started run |\n323:| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/finalize
` | Finalize a chunked run (idempotent) |\n324:| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts` | Store one artifact's raw bytes (widget HTML to
o large to send inline) and return its `storageId` |\n325:| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts/upload-url` | Retired. Answers `410 Go
ne` with `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload artifacts with `POST .../eval-ingest/arti
facts` instead |\n332:| `POST .../agent` | Run ONE assistant turn over a `messages` history (`{role: \"user\"\\|\"assistant\", con
tent}` items, max 50 messages × 8 KB each, 96 KB total). The model is pinned server-side and billed to the project. The turn can r
ead project servers/suites/runs and **create eval suites**; it can NOT start runs — kick those off yourself with `POST .../eval-ru
ns`. Responds synchronously with `reply`, the `toolCalls` it made, `createdResources` (ids + app links), and token `usage`. Capped
at 4 concurrent turns per organization and \\~90 s wall clock. **Not idempotent — never blind-retry**: dedupe on your own trigger
identity, and on an error response check `details.createdResources` (and, after a lost response, list suites) before retrying, or
you'll create duplicates |\n396:> The generation routes consume **no customer credits** — the model cost is on\n397:> MCPJam. The
y are still subject to usage limits, and each limit means a\n403:> on every one: buying credits does not lift them, so do not retr
y in a loop\n412:| `POST .../goals/{goalId}/runs` | **Launch.** Answers `202` — the fan-out has started, not finished. Send `Idemp
otency-Key`. Optional `expectedSponsored` is how many conversations you expect MCPJam to sponsor; a different actual split is a `4
09` (`details.code: swarm_funding_changed`) and nothing is created. The response can report `funding` (`sponsored`, `credits`, `to
tal`) |\n419:* **Always send `Idempotency-Key` on a launch.** It spends model credits, so a\n439:**Swarms — insights** — what a ru
